title: Juicy Cozy Dutch Apple Stir-fry
description: A sour and juicy Dutch dish featuring applesauce in a cozy, kosher-friendly twist.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt. Place a small saucepan over medium heat and add unsweetened applesauce, apple cider vinegar, dill, thyme, and enough water or broth to thin it out slightly (about 1/4 cup). Bring to a simmer.
Place seasoned chicken on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush both sides of each piece with butter.
Pour the sauce over the chicken, making sure all pieces are coated evenly. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until juices run clear when pierced with a knife.
Garnish with fresh herbs if desired before serving.
